verdict.rationale: Core resources are clearly programmable. The SDK creates assistants in code, the CLI and official MCP server expose Vapi APIs to manage assistants, phone numbers and calls, and voice and transient configurations are set via assistant config properties. However, several capabilities are documented only as Dashboard actions: turning on HIPAA compliance, browsing the Voice Library to look up voice IDs, and web-call testing via Talk. Nothing explicitly claims full API/UI parity. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or reference showing every dashboard feature is in the API, documented API paths for HIPAA/compliance and voice-library lookup, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
